headline: Gemini app's task toggle makes permission review a daily habit

source.title: Gemini 4 Argon comes to the Gemini app

read_evidence.scope: Complete Google October 13 Gemini app release covering task versus chat toggle, connected third-party apps, macOS coding pathway, Pro/Ultra eligibility and task progress updates.

reading_estimation_basis.source_word_count_method: original publisher article main-text editorial estimate

reading_time_evidence.caveat: Editorial approximation, not measured reader session

summary: Google says Gemini 4 Argon is available in its app for AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, alongside a new chat-to-tasks toggle. It describes background task execution across more than 40 connected apps, including grocery, booking, design and commerce services. The announcement outlines access and features, but provides no independent completion or safety rate for these workflows.
why_it_matters: Start with a reversible, low-value task such as preparing a shopping comparison. Review connected accounts and every proposed transaction, and insist on approval before bookings, purchases or external messages. Judge reliability from documented outcomes rather than promotional capability claims.
related_coverage: See companion October 14 coverage for engineering, responsible tasks, knowledge context and safe skills.
image_alt_intent: Chat-to-task mode toggle connected to permission-scoped services, with separate plan preview, reversible draft actions, final human confirmation barrier and execution receipt, no automatic purchase.
